deep_analysis:
PORTFOLIO FLAT (0/6 slots) in a STRONG_DOWN SHORT_BIAS tape — we have zero exposure while BTC sits below EMA300 (337 candles) with LEAN_BEAR linreg and STRONG_NEG zscore. Flat beats long-in-a-bear, but it also means zero participation in the only profitable side: shorts.

The 48h ledger is unambiguous about which side was right. LONGs: every RSI band negative (mid-band 45-55 worst at 20%WR/-0.83; oversold <35 0%WR/-0.33; even 'sweet spot' 55-65 at 44%WR/-0.57). SHORTs: the 55-65 band went 100%WR/+0.47 (ALT, pump-chain-v6-). 24h totals confirm: SHORTS net +0.38, LONGS net -0.28. We kept buying pumps in a market that was selling them.

pump-chain+ LONG is the bleeding wound (7d): 20 trades, only atr_trail_hit makes money (+2.17 on 6/8 trending winners). The other exits bleed: hard_max_loss 0%WR/-0.91, trail_arm_timeout 3/11/-0.41, atr_sl_hit 0/4/-0.55. Average entry RSI on those losers: 62-65 — we are systematically longing into overbought levels while BTC trends down. The winning side of every one of those losses was a SHORT at the same RSI. IO, BLUR, WCT 'trail_arm_timeout' losses are chop entries that never reached +0.40% arm — same signature as the hard_max_loss family.

The exit-reason split (48h) tells the trend-vs-chop story cleanly: profit-monster-trail 7/8 wins +0.25 and trail_sl +0.47 are the trending trades; atr_sl_hit (13 trades, 1 win, -1.17) and hard_max_loss (0/6, -0.75) are the chop trades. Trend is friend; chop is theft. We entered chop 19 times in 48 hours.

ai-trader+ also bleeding: WLD LONG -0.15 (RSI 52.6), INJ LONG -0.20 (RSI 64) — same wrong-side pattern, plus the documented APT drift case (pick RSI 57.1 -> fill 33.7 = hard_max_loss). USELESS SHORT (09:01 pick) expired unfilled — no trade opened.
regime_context:
BTC: SHORT_BIAS on both 15m and 4h. Price 81,980 hugging EMA300 (AT, 337 candles duration) after a long stay below — this is a bear tape trying to base, not a bull reversal. linreg LEAN_BEAR (1m/5m/15m slopes all negative, 1h slightly positive), zscore STRONG_NEG (-1.55), velocity SLOW, acceleration FLAT, volume LOW. Market phase labelled RECOVERY but trend_quality STRONG_DOWN — recovery labels are premature while every short-term slope points down.

15m regime scanner: 75 SHORT_BIAS vs 4 LONG_BIAS across 126 tokens (overall SHORT_BIAS). Strongest confirmed downtrends: USELESS (conf 94.2), AIXBT (94.0), SUSHI (93.1), SUI (92.6), WLD (92.2). This is a short-first tape. LONG signals should be treated as counter-trend gambles, not default posture. Volatility LOW — position sizing should reflect it (smaller ATR room for SL/TP).

PATTERN 1 — LONG in SHORT_BIAS regime = wrong side. n=8 LONG/24h: 37.5%WR, -0.28. n=5 SHORT/24h: 40%WR, +0.38. 48h by RSI band: LONG all bands negative (worst mid 45-55: 20%WR/-0.83 n=10); SHORT 55-65 band 100%WR/+0.47. WINNING SIDE of every recent long loss: short the same pump. Why weren't we on it? pump-chain+ fires LONG on pump structure regardless of BTC regime direction — entries averaged RSI 62-65 (overbought) while BTC trended down.

PATTERN 2 — Chop entries never arm the trail. pump-chain+ LONG 7d exit split: atr_trail_hit 6/8 wins +2.17 (trend winners) vs hard_max_loss 0/9 -0.91 + trail_arm_timeout 3/11 -0.41 + atr_sl_hit 0/4 -0.55 (chop losers). 52/56 hard_max_loss trades historically never reach +0.40% arm. IO (RSI 57.1), BLUR (62.5), WCT (27.8) trail_arm_timeout losses this week are the same signature. WINNING SIDE: no trade, or short the same range. The arm-timeout family is pure chop entry — the trail only works in trend.

PATTERN 3 — Exit quality confirms trend/chop split (48h, all signals): profit-monster-trail 7/8 +0.25, trail_sl 1/1 +0.47 (trend exits) vs atr_sl_hit 1/13 -1.17, hard_max_loss 0/6 -0.75 (chop exits). 19 of 26 closed trades exited via chop-family reasons. We are not losing on exits; we are losing on entries into chop.

PATTERN 4 — ai-trader+ LONG drift + wrong side: WLD LONG -0.15 (meta_rsi 52.6, hard_sl), INJ LONG -0.20 (meta_rsi 64, atr_sl), APT LONG -0.09 (pick 57.1 -> fill 33.7, hard_max_loss). WINNING SIDE: short WLD/INJ at those RSI levels. Fix applied: rsi_at_pick + drift gate now in ai_trader_state.
